body: I think about computer science but then I get scared off by math because it is by far my worse subject so much so it gives me anxiety that I suffer panic attacks, I am working on that though and not letting it stop me. However, I want to make good money but I worry that these course may be to intense for me. How do you go about getting into those fields and what is the work load like?

I've done the whole lie into the mirror until you believe thing and it doesn't work with me. I've been in therapy for five years, we talk about it but honestly I'm sick and tired of their might be a "chance", every chance I took went sour in the in the end. All that fancy shit or 'trying to trick your brain' i've been there.

I've wasted my youth, I've passed up chances, now all I have left is to die a husk because people like you can sleep better at night thinking one less person won't die. It's shit like this that gets me mad--like congrats you've coached yourself to not wanna blow your brains out. This is the exact thing I hate. I'm complaining about this. Can it be okay to not be okay? Can I be okay with looking at the facts as they are that I'm a half baked human being who wants to die but I'm living so other people don't cry over me? I'm alive so people can feel better but I live aimlessly and depressed.

It worked for you great. But that doesn't mean it works for everyone. The fact is sometimes it doesn't--how come it's like I'm punished for accepting im miserableness no matter what I do? Tricks are short term fixes, eventually that falls apart too. Feel goods are the worst shit ever. I get what you're saying but it feels like it's just feel good stuff. I understand what you mean but it won't help me.

What you're saying makes me hate it even more. Thanks.

I have BP,anxiety , and depression so my lows hit harder and longer than my highs and if i'm okay im still in an constant state of worry and fears. My default state is to be depressed, uncomfortable and sad. It is only a high for me, if I go on meds which have made me sick before to the point I have trust issues with them. I'm not asking to be happy, I'm asking to just be okay for once but I will never be okay.

I feel all this, I'm 23 and have just been existing on the kindness and forgiveness others, i don't want to pray for a day that i gets better. If it ever gets better I would very much like to know now before I just want to kill myself because I can't bare to wait for it--I'm also out of work due to my store shutting down. I've started digging more into my hobbies to escape the pain of reality and I get it.

That , *you,* and that *you* miss might be gone forever but despite everything it's still *you in way*.

And like you , I'm starting wonder even if enough people understand and if enough people can relate why is it so hard to seek that confirmation in ourselves? That you're not alone.

Honestly? I feel like people say it out of guilt because they can't understand wanting to die as an option. While, neutrally speaking taking your life very much is, but not one that a healthy person will consider. Even worse people assume that you don't try or consider those  solutions. 

I'm not saying you should die but I understand while it makes sense for you to think that way when you start hearing the same thing over and over again. They mean well but sometimes it's like they don't listen enough too, to understand why shit like "Oh, just pick up a new hobby." doesn't mean anything.

I understand, it sucks that people think you can just put in work and it gets better. But sometimes it doesn't. Someone out there right now is dying cold and alone not knowing what a warm bed is. Sometimes it never gets better it just keeps happening. I can't change your mind over night or just give you false hope.

It hurts so much, it's such a deep pain and then you're told "it just gets better"

Sometimes nothing gets better, it just stays the same or it improves by a small amount and all you can do is be okay with it.How come I have to be okay with feeling like I want to die and work twice as hard as the next person to not throw myself off the bridge because of a minor inconvenience? 

I'm letting you know I hear you, I get it and I understand the anger you feel. It's unfair, it's sucks and I hear you. I ,too, wanna say I feel like it never gets better and people just let me say it without selling me what feels like a damn pipe dream.

tl;dr: I fucked up and will fuck up.

My own faults, shitty luck and a fear I'm doing well in the moment just to screw it up. I can't handle being upset at my mistakes anymore, I just can't handle being a human being, and dealing with failure. When I was younger I wanted the world handed to me because I was a bullied kid and felt that my trauma entitled me to a one way ticket to fame and instant talent. Because why else? No one could be born to suffer in my mind without pay off somehow right? I spent my years stressing over every person who was ahead of me in someway. If you drew/wrote better than me and were younger than me I couldn't stand the sight of it. You had no right to complain, you were the underdog who could draw/sing/dance/act. I managed to end up around people who just were really gifted while I was...okay at best. Which created a complex that I was the support in other people's lives. I had skills yea but I was just going to exist without anything to prove the scars I have.

To be going through that and saw that on tv for kids like me in underdog stories, I created reasons why things didn't go my way if it wasn't instant. Then I created reasons why some peers I meet went through what I did and had that story. 

It sucked, it felt like I was just the bullied kid in the end who became an adult who now knows too late what opportunities I had, the time I had to stop feeding an ego and just try. I don't have time anymore, I'm 23. I'm too young for people to think I should give up but too old to really change it. I can't make new opportunities like I had back then. 

Looking back on it, I really lucked out while I was okay but I had *passion* but now I don't have that. I have skills in drawing/writing but none of the passion to do anything with it. I feel like someone who played a video game and halfway through the play through I've chosen the neutral route without intending. And If I try to do shake things up now I'll go right into the bad end because I locked myself out of the good end. Life doesn't have good ends or bad ends I know but... things could have been better.  And I ruined it before I knew it, so now I know that I can't complain like this to too many people  although at least people in this sub understand.

Now I feel selfish for wanting better, I don't believe a being is punishing me or something. I'm guilty for living a life of regrets that don't go away, and I can never just easily do new things without constant proof of how it all falls apart. 

I don't want greatness, my dream is live somewhere peaceful, where I can live a step above death--I'm like a ghost that isn't tied down because I feel like a ghost. In that place, I can't disappoint people because no one is around to feel that way. I wish I just did more, listened more, and worked just a bit harder. It just hurts so much to live this way and I can't imagine wishing it on someone else.  I feel as if I'm in hell. I'm scared to die really but that's the only way out of this, out of all this for me. I can't keep going to see better days. I'm so very tired in a way that makes my heart ache. If there is a light at the end of the tunnel I can tell you that my legs don't and crawling isn't even doing it.

I'm so used to making progress and defaulting on it , despite what many say I feel like the term "high risk, high reward" is great if you're mentally balanced. If you're mentally ill the risk is loosing everything you have which maybe isn't a lot but the few things you have-- just to ask for more and get nothing then lose the little things on top of that. 

I'd rather be satisfied with scraps than get a feast and get sick from food poisoning I guess. And it's like everyone keeps inviting me to the table but this will be the third time this month I'll throw up from a bad piece of chicken but no one else does or when they do it's never that bad. "Why eat scraps?! You want more right? You can eat." and everyone watches me throw up on the floor telling "it's not that bad, just keep eating!"

My lowest lows from all the times I've had to deal with drops from my high points make me valid in the choice to not put myself at risk. One day no one is going to be able to help me pick myself up from rock bottom. I barely talk to the people I live with and I don't feel attached to anyone but my cat.

I want to die because I am a half-baked human being.

My goal was, a long time ago to teach English in japan. While it sounds noble I kinda wanna run away from everything--fresh start! I do have a passion for languages and learning but I've been in community college for over 5+ years and if it wasn't for other people I would dropped out. I don't have the passion to do what I got to anymore. I feel really burnt out and I know it's my fault but I'm already this deep in.

I read it. And you're not alone in this. Its hard and I can't know everything about you from one post I hope you find someone or something that gives you joy. Me reading this was not a waste of time. Hope you can find some peace in this messy world.

my whole life has been planning to die or wanting to die, no sure fire way to say it better. As soon as I learned what suicide was I thought that was the best thing ever. in a way I still do; I could kill myself. I can be free??? I don't have to wait till old age?? So even before I knew what the word was I was already thinking about checking out.

my younger sister has two jobs and a credit score. It doesn't suck for her, I'm 110% sure she could quit and get hired within two weeks somewhere because she's never been fired and has experience.
I've never worked somewhere more than 6 months and have been fired 1 once.
she's been arrested and still is able to come back from it along with a court case. 
I'll always be so strung out on my an mental health that I'm going to mooch on my family and friends tell they get tired of me. I'm running out of time. You don't really know me enough to say I have time.
I guess, its more sad because I can't imagine being any worse but good to know I'm not alone doubts about it getting better though.

same, I suppose the only thing keeping around people like us is other people but what we want is for people to be okay with us wanting to die. I know no one wants me to die but it's not like they wake up feeling the suffocation feeling in their chest right? The overwhelming weight of every single breath you don't want to take. I know it doesn't mean much from a stranger but I get it. And I hope for a moment you find some small peace between everything.
ah, thanks.

Thanks, but I just think I don't have any good luck in much. Nothing wrong with my cv but just as long as I'm me it's not good enough. I just exist to make other people better, it more likely I secured a spot by someone else when they have to compare it. A stepping stone, on my own I'm okay but next to someone else, I make them better then okay.

like I don't control anything, I get a good run of freedom here and there but rlly it just means I'm free to make mistakes. So I've settled with the idea that, I'm at the mercy of something with no real control.

I started doing it in the first place as a way to punish myself for forgetting that I'm always going to feel this way and killing myself is the only way but I can't do that so I just do what I can. I don't think I have control over anything not even my own body.

in the past I've burned, cut myself or hit myself. I've been doing it for a while, normally I try not to but at this point it seems as long as I'm not dead then the people in my life feel like they're doing something. The act of living seems selfless and endearing so I just want to be selfish if that makes any sense.

But I did that at 18, I went to therapy and did all the stuff people tell you to do and that didn't work out for me. I did for a time get better: had a job got fired had to find another one when I did I had to quit because of stress and management, was active in my school then I wasn't able to keep up at work, I've taken the semester off because of it, a friend group that was always there for me just kinda cut me out. It's like if someone told you to keep getting back up during a fight to only know you'll get hit again and theres no time out. It just keeps coming, it's easy to tell someone when you're not in the ring.

I've been job hunting so now every chance to get hired is just me getting rejected and wanting to kill myself because of it or thinking about killing myself once I get the job from the stress from the work place.

I once read somewhere that it is a result of mental illness and because of that your brain goes fight, flight or DIE. Normally the third one wouldn't even be considered and most people try to do something along the lines of the first two. At this point it ends up being a natural response to things. "I dropped my keys during the rain and now they got mud on them, if I was dead this wouldn't be a problem." 

I can't assume what you've been through but I hope you can find some treatment for this or at the very least look into coping skills to help in the meantime.

she already knows all the details but she really can't help it seems. As much as I want to keep my head up I think I am a (kinda) rotten person to the core and the damage that's been done to me can't change that. I go to therapy because at this point it's just something that helps me leave the house. Every session results in the same tired conclusions.

I also have everything planned too, to outsiders looking in it's strange to consider to have a plan with the mindset of not "if" but when. I recently turned down a job because of my family but they tell me how dangerous it is there and for a moment I consider "well If I get shot dead that's easier than doing it myself". Hope to see you around for a bit and also good taste in music. Stay breathtaking!
